sn7.18:1.1: Ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn7.18:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmim bhāradvājagottassa brāhmaṇassa sambahulā antevasikā kaṭṭhahārakā māṇavakā yena vaṇasaṇḍo ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || || 3. Upasaṅkamitvā addasaṃsu Bhagavantaṃ tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe nisinnaṃ pallaṅkam ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satim upaṭṭhapetvā || || disvāna yena bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || || 4. Upasaṅkamitvā bhāradvājagottam brāhmaṇam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn7.18:1.4: asukasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe samaṇo nisinno pallaṅkam ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satim upaṭṭhapetvā || || 5.
sn7.18:1.5: Atha kho bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo tehi māṇavakehi saddhiṃ yena so vanasaṇḍo ten-upasaṅkami ||
sn7.18:1.6: addasā kho Bhagavantaṃ tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe nisinnaṃ pallaṅkam ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satim upaṭṭhapetvā ||
sn7.18:1.7: disvāna yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.18:3.1: Na yattha gītaṃ na pi yattha vāditaṃ ||
sn7.18:7.1: Evaṃ vutte bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.18:7.2: Abhikkantam bho Gotama abhikkantam bho Gotama || pa ||
sn7.18:7.3: ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || || 2.
